text: dsh-token-optimizer 是面向 DSH Web 的上下文与工具结果优化插件。它在工具执行后压缩较长的纯文本结果，并把原文归档以供按会话恢复；同时注册 retrieve_spill、会话统计投影和对话输入区仪表盘，并提供默认阈值为 62.5% 的自动上下文压缩引擎。适合希望减少重复工具输出占用、查看 token 节省量并保留原文检索能力的 DSH 用户。归档写入本机 DSH 数据目录；不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-token-optimizer is a DSH Web plugin that compresses long tool results, archives originals for retrieval, and compacts context at a 62.5% default threshold. It also adds a session statistics projection and conversation dashboard. Archives stay on the local machine; no extra API key is needed.
DSH 的工具返回太长，能不能自动缩短并保留原文？
想减少重复工具输出占用的上下文 token。
怎么在 DSH 会话里找回已经压缩的工具结果？
让 DSH 在上下文压力升高时自动整理会话。
我想在 Web 对话页面查看 token 节省和上下文占用。
PTC 子调用日志很长时，能否压缩显示但仍能恢复完整文本？
Can DSH shorten long tool outputs while keeping the originals retrievable?
I want automatic context compaction when a session gets close to its limit.
dsh-token-optimizer 的功能「工具结果压缩」：工具执行后检查成功的纯文本结果，按长度选择规范化或头尾预览并替换模型上下文中的内容；压缩原文会先归档。
dsh-token-optimizer 的功能「恢复归档原文」：通过 retrieve_spill 工具提交 SPILL_ID，可按字符偏移和窗口大小读取被压缩的完整结果。
dsh-token-optimizer 的功能「自动上下文压缩」：插件默认挂载 compaction 引擎，使用 62.5% 默认阈值；可通过 compaction 配置关闭该引擎。
dsh-token-optimizer 的功能「Web 会话统计面板」：在对话输入区展示估算 token 节省、上下文占用、缓存命中率、压缩次数和 compaction 次数。
dsh-token-optimizer 使用前须知：完整工具结果会保存在本机 DSH 数据目录的会话归档中，以便之后按 SPILL_ID 恢复；归档路径可通过 archiveRoot 配置。

dsh-token-optimizer README · dsh-token-optimizer：Deterministic, recoverable tool-result compression and cache-aware compaction for DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`.

[中文文档](README.zh.md)

dsh-token-optimizer README · What it does：- Compresses large successful text tool results before they repeatedly enter the model context.
- Compresses PTC sub-dispatch log copies without changing the complete structured values received by `run_code` programs.
- Archives every lossy replacement and exposes `retrieve_spill` for exact, session-authorized recovery.
- Provides a root-level `BasicCompactionEngine` adapter with a 62.5% default threshold while preserving DSH's cache-aware replay, branded Session API, and routed image accounting.
- Adds a Web conversation dashboard through the split Conversation, Renderer, and Session client contracts.
- Declares a localized title, description, and icon so Plugin Manager shows it as a first-class bundle.

dsh-token-optimizer README · Install：Install the `0.2.5` bundle into a DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-optimizer@0.2.5
```

Restart the existing `dsh web` process after installation. The bundle enables recoverable tool-result compression, spill retrieval, projection, the Web dashboard, and the 62.5% automatic compaction engine across all four shipped agent modes. No user preset copy is required.

dsh-token-optimizer README · Install：The root engine observes each agent's pressure and overflow lifecycle. In Standard, PTC, and Creator modes it runs before the isolated stock engine, so the surface is reduced at 62.5% and the stock 80% fallback has no second reduction to perform. Minimal mode has no preset compaction group and uses the root engine directly. The optional [`preset-cordis.yml`](preset-cordis.yml) fragment remains for deployments that deliberately want to replace a preset's isolated provider itself; do not edit shipped presets. DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` ships the four presets as extra patch layers inside its Web bundle, so a user-copied preset from an older DSH should be revalidated against the current composition before reuse.

dsh-token-optimizer README · Install：DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` ships its own spill subsystem (`dsh-spill-local` plus `dsh-spill-policy` at `maxInlineTokens: 12500`). The optimizer keeps its durable archive as the retrieval authority and mirrors each replacement into that backend when it is present, so the two coexist without compressing the same result twice.

dsh-token-optimizer README · Install：Since DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` the host checks a plugin's `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges at startup. **`0.2.0-rc.2` turned that check from fail-soft into fail-closed:** a bundle whose ranges do not match the runtime is refused outright rather than disabled in place. This plugin declares `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0`, so one release covers `0.1.5-rc.3` through `0.2.x` while explicitly refusing the unaudited `0.3.0`. The previous `^0.1.5-rc.1` range could not reach `0.2.0` — a caret on a `0.x` version only authorises patch movement, which is why `0.2.2` is skipped on every `0.2.x` runtime. `0.2.1-rc.2` adds an optional `engines.dsh` range that would take precedence over the peers when present; this plugin deliberately keeps the peer form, so exactly one requirement surface stays authoritative. See [the 0.2.0-rc.2 peer-gate section](docs/dsh-0.2.0-rc.2-compatibility.md#1-the-peer-gate-and-why-022-stops-loading) and [the 0.2.1-rc.2 gate section](docs/dsh-0.2.1-rc.2-compatibility.md#1-the-peer-gate-in-021-rc2-enginesdsh-joins-peer-arithmetic-is-unchanged) for the measured matrices.

dsh-token-optimizer README · Configuration：This plugin's early compaction is controlled by one boolean, `compaction`, which defaults to on:

```yaml

dsh-token-optimizer README · Turn the plugin's 62.5% early compaction off：- id: dsh-token-optimizer
  config:
    compaction: false
```

With it off, no root `ctx.compaction` provider and no pressure/overflow listener is registered, while tool-result compression, `retrieve_spill`, the session projection, and the dashboard all stay active. Three things to know:
section: Turn the plugin's 62.5% early compaction off

text:
dsh-token-optimizer README · Turn the plugin's 62.5% early compaction off：1. It disables this plugin's early compaction, not all compaction: the isolated stock engines shipped with Standard, PTC, and Creator still fall back at 80%, so you return to the DSH default you had before installing the plugin. Minimal has no compaction group and therefore no compaction at all once it is off.yaml
- id: dsh-token-optimizer
  config:
    thresholdRatio: 0.5
    retainRatio: 0.16
```

`retainRatio` must stay below `thresholdRatio`, or the upstream engine refuses to load.

The current test suite covers deterministic compression, persistent recovery, session lineage authorization, compaction defaults, the compaction switch, DSH projection behavior, and real tool-runtime integration.

dsh-token-optimizer README · Compatibility：`0.2.0` removed the retired `dsh-client-runtime` dependency, uses the split Conversation/Renderer/Session client graph, folds projections through the on-demand Session log API, and handles PTC durable dispatch logs. See [the 0.1.2-rc.1 compatibility research](docs/dsh-0.1.2-rc.1-compatibility.md).

dsh-token-optimizer README · Compatibility：`0.2.1` adapts to the `SpillSource` discriminated union that `dsh-spill` gained — tool producers must now declare `kind: 'tool'` — and raises every declared DSH range to `0.1.5-rc.1`. No other plugin surface changed between the two releases. See [the 0.1.5-rc.1 compatibility audit](docs/dsh-0.1.5-rc.1-compatibility.md).

dsh-token-optimizer README · Compatibility：`0.2.2` adapts to `0.1.7-rc.2`: it follows the removal of the `tool-result` wrapper block, adopts the awaited `agent/created` contract, mirrors the new upstream `headroomTokens` field behind two compile-time drift assertions, and declares plugin metadata for Plugin Manager. The `compaction` switch can also now turn the plugin's early compaction off. It keeps supporting `0.1.5-rc.3`, because the host's peer check accepts `^0.1.5-rc.1` for the whole `0.1.x` line. See [the 0.1.7-rc.2 compatibility audit](docs/dsh-0.1.7-rc.2-compatibility.md).

dsh-token-optimizer README · Compatibility：`0.2.4` adapts to `0.2.1-rc.2`. No plugin-facing declaration changed in a way this plugin can observe, and no source line changed: thirteen of the sixteen audited packages differ at the `.d.ts` level, but every difference is additive, internal, or a doc-comment rewrite, the three core contract packages (`dsh-compaction-basic`, `dsh-session-projection`, `dsh-spill`) are byte-identical, and `cordis` 4.0.5 / `schemastery` 3.18.5 emit identical declarations. The release re-pins the tested closure and certifies compress → archive → retrieve on a real `0.2.1-rc.2` headless session. See [the 0.2.1-rc.2 compatibility audit](docs/dsh-0.2.1-rc.2-compatibility.md).

dsh-token-optimizer README · Compatibility：`0.2.5` adapts to `0.2.1-rc.5`. Fifteen of the sixteen audited packages are byte-identical at the `.d.ts` level; the only change is `dsh-client-ui-conversation`, and it is purely additive (View tabs and pins, the header More menu, draft handling, `MessageSubmissionState.newSession`/`agentPreset`), so no source line changed and all 24 tests pass on the real `0.2.1-rc.5` closure. The launcher's gate implementation is byte-identical to `0.2.1-rc.2`, the existing `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0` peer window still loads through `0.2.1-rc.5` and still refuses `0.3.0`, and a real headless `0.2.1-rc.5` session was certified end to end: a 34,532-character tool result compressed to a `mode=large` spill with a matching SHA-256 artifact, `retrieve_spill` recovered it in a later turn, and the `tokenOptimizer` projection folded the saving. See [the 0.2.1-rc.5 compatibility audit](docs/dsh-0.2.1-rc.5-compatibility.md).

dsh-token-optimizer README · Compatibility：`0.2.3` adapts to `0.2.0-rc.2`. No plugin-facing declaration changed in a way this plugin can observe — fourteen of the sixteen audited packages are byte-identical at the `.d.ts` level, and the two that moved (`dsh-session`'s repair internals, `dsh-client-ui-conversation`'s submission analytics) are outside its surface, so the `0.2.2` sources compile and all 24 tests pass unchanged. The release exists because the launcher's peer gate became fail-closed: the declared range moves to `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0`, which is what keeps the bundle loading on `0.2.x` while still covering `0.1.x`. See [the 0.2.0-rc.2 compatibility audit](docs/dsh-0.2.0-rc.2-compatibility.md).
dsh-token-optimizer README · Compatibility：The DSH packages remain optional peer dependencies so the profile runtime supplies the matching services.
